scope: One same-machine corrected-guard G64 T200 block. Corrected T30/Q1 and T30/Q10 were already measured and audited in a separate three-cell block; this report does not combine or select among the four points. No controlled repeat, statistical claim, H128 transfer result, or full LTR claim.
work_semantics: Natural EOS/output lengths and sequences may differ by policy; token-rate and completion differences are not equal-work speedups.
